messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In one study, plasma clearance in people aged 65 and over was about 40% lower than in adults aged 25 to 32.
It took 2 to 3 weeks to reach steady levels rather than about 1 week.
Doctors usually start older adults at the low end of the dose range.
Older adults are at greater risk of low sodium levels in the blood.
This risk is particularly high if older adults take diuretics.
This risk is also particularly high if older adults are dehydrated.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has risk for", "older adults who are dehydrated"]

The relation 'has risk for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with an increased risk of the condition or situation specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has risk factor': The subject condition or event is associated with an increased risk of the factor specified by the object entity.
B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'may worsen': The subject drug may cause the medical condition specified by the object entity to become more severe.
E. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
